Name: Magical Flowers Letter
Author: Geminia
Description:
[b][size=5]Magical Flowers Letter
[/size][/b]
Excited by all things magical? Added Eemie and Manakirel's updated mods?  This mod adds some lore to the game to explain the addition of those craftables.


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. Unpack and place the "[CP] Magical Flowers Letter" folder into your Mods folder. 



[size=4][b]Questions/Issues[/b][/size]
  If you have any questions or issues, make a post or report a bug. You can also find me over in Modding on Discord, just ping Geminia#9128.
